# MatchClaim { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim()
```

A claim that two events or coordinates on different timelines correspond.

A MatchClaim always knows which two timelines it connects via top-level
``timeline_a_id`` and ``timeline_b_id`` fields. Anchors are only present
for synchronous claims.

## Four cases {.doc-section .doc-section-four-cases}

(a) ``from_events``: Two timed things on different timelines correspond.
(b) ``from_projection``: An event is projected onto a timeline with no
    matching event.
(c) ``nomatch``: An event has no equivalent on the other timeline.
(d) ``implicit``: Implicit claim generated by MatchGraph group extension.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name              | Type                                                                      | Description                                                                                                                        |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline_a_id     | [str](`str`)                                                              | First timeline's unique identifier.                                                                                                |
| timeline_b_id     | [str](`str`)                                                              | Second timeline's unique identifier.                                                                                               |
| start_anchor      | [AlignmentAnchor](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.AlignmentAnchor`) \| None | AlignmentAnchor for event starts (None for non-synchronous).                                                                       |
| end_anchor        | [AlignmentAnchor](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.AlignmentAnchor`) \| None | AlignmentAnchor for event ends (None for instants or non-synchronous claims).                                                      |
| is_synchronous    | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | True if temporally synchronous matches.                                                                                            |
| is_explicit       | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | True if directly claimed, False if inferred.                                                                                       |
| metadata          | [MatchMetadata](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchMetadata`) \| None     | Provenance information (agent, criteria, certainty).                                                                               |
| source_claim_id   | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | For implicit claims, the ID of the claim that generated this one.                                                                  |
| event_a_id        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | ID of the event on timeline A (if known).                                                                                          |
| event_a_name      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | Name/label of the event on timeline A (if known).                                                                                  |
| event_b_id        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | ID of the event on timeline B (if known).                                                                                          |
| event_b_name      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                      | Name/label of the event on timeline B (if known).                                                                                  |
| source_coordinate | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None                       | Unmatched source-side coordinate for a NOMATCH claim. None for synchronous claims, whose coordinate is held by the anchor instead. |
| id                | [str](`str`)                                                              | Unique identifier for this claim.                                                                                                  |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Synchronous instant match via factory
>>> claim = MatchClaim.from_events(
...     event_a={"id": "e001", "name": "Note C4", "start": 100.0},
...     tl_a_id="score:1",
...     event_b={"id": "e042", "name": "Note C4", "start": 45.5},
...     tl_b_id="recording:1",
...     unit_a=TimeUnit.quarters,
...     unit_b=TimeUnit.seconds,
... )
>>> claim.event_a_id
'e001'
>>> claim.event_a_name
'Note C4'
```

```python
>>> # Non-synchronous claim (no anchors)
>>> claim = MatchClaim.nomatch(
...     event={"id": "orphan", "start": 100.0},
...     source_tl_id="score:1",
...     target_tl_id="recording:1",
...     unit=TimeUnit.quarters,
... )
>>> claim.start_anchor is None
True
```

### from_dict { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_dict }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_dict(data)
```

Deserialize from dictionary.

Two normalisations precede validation: an absent timeline ID is
taken from the start anchor, and a missing or null ``id`` becomes
the empty string that triggers ID generation.

### from_events { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_events }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_events(
    event_a,
    tl_a_id,
    event_b,
    tl_b_id,
    *,
    unit_a,
    unit_b,
    coord_key='start',
    end_coord_key=None,
    is_synchronous=True,
    metadata=None,
)
```

Case (a): Two timed things on different timelines correspond.

| Name           | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                                           | Default    |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event_a        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                   | Event dict from timeline A (must contain ``coord_key``). May also contain ``id`` and ``name`` fields. | _required_ |
| tl_a_id        | [str](`str`)                                                          | Timeline A's ID.                                                                                      | _required_ |
| event_b        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                   | Event dict from timeline B (must contain ``coord_key``). May also contain ``id`` and ``name`` fields. | _required_ |
| tl_b_id        | [str](`str`)                                                          | Timeline B's ID.                                                                                      | _required_ |
| unit_a         | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)               | Unit of timeline A's coordinates.                                                                     | _required_ |
| unit_b         | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)               | Unit of timeline B's coordinates.                                                                     | _required_ |
| coord_key      | [str](`str`)                                                          | Key for start coordinate in event dicts.                                                              | `'start'`  |
| end_coord_key  | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Key for end coordinate (creates interval match).                                                      | `None`     |
| is_synchronous | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Whether events are temporally synchronous.                                                            | `True`     |
| metadata       | [MatchMetadata](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchMetadata`) \| None | Provenance information.                                                                               | `None`     |

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                  |

### from_projection { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_projection }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_projection(
    event,
    source_tl_id,
    target_tl_id,
    target_coord,
    *,
    source_unit,
    target_unit=None,
    coord_key='start',
    target_end_coord=None,
    end_coord_key=None,
    metadata=None,
)
```

Case (b): An event is projected onto a timeline with no matching event.

The source event has a coordinate; the target coordinate is specified
explicitly (e.g., computed by interpolation or DTW).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                  | Default    |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event            | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                   | Event dict from the source timeline. May contain ``id`` and ``name`` fields. | _required_ |
| source_tl_id     | [str](`str`)                                                          | Source timeline's ID.                                                        | _required_ |
| target_tl_id     | [str](`str`)                                                          | Target timeline's ID.                                                        | _required_ |
| target_coord     | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`)                   | Projected coordinate specification on the target timeline.                   | _required_ |
| source_unit      | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)               | Unit of the source timeline's coordinates.                                   | _required_ |
| target_unit      | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None       | Unit of the target timeline's coordinates.                                   | `None`     |
| coord_key        | [str](`str`)                                                          | Key for start coordinate in event dict.                                      | `'start'`  |
| target_end_coord | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.CoordinateSpec`) \| None           | Projected end coordinate specification (creates interval match).             | `None`     |
| end_coord_key    | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Key for end coordinate in event dict.                                        | `None`     |
| metadata         | [MatchMetadata](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchMetadata`) \| None | Provenance information.                                                      | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                         |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A synchronous MatchClaim with 1 or 2 anchors and source event info. |

### from_row { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.from_row }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.from_row(row)
```

Reconstruct a claim from a struct-shaped Arrow row dict.

This is the entry point ``SemanticField.__getitem__`` uses to
materialise a scalar from the backing struct column.  The row dict
carries the nested ``start_anchor`` / ``end_anchor`` / ``metadata``
sub-dicts (or ``None`` for absent slots), so the shape is exactly the
one :meth:`from_dict` already accepts.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                         | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| row    | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The ``.as_py()`` dict of one struct-column element. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                          |
|--------|----------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A reconstructed :class:`MatchClaim`. |

### get_matchstamp { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.get_matchstamp }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.get_matchstamp(
    bundle=None,
    from_graph=True,
    conversion_maps=False,
)
```

Return a MatchStamp for this claim's start anchor.

With ``from_graph=True`` (the default), the method builds or retrieves
the full MatchGraph for this claim's coordinate from the bundle's
cache and returns the FULL MatchStamp combining timestamps from ALL
groups connected at this coordinate.

With ``from_graph=False``, constructs a **reduced** MatchStamp from
only the two timelines in this claim (no graph construction needed).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                         | Default   |
|-----------------|-----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| bundle          | \'AlignmentBundle \| None\' | The ``AlignmentBundle`` containing this claim. Required for ``from_graph=True``. Provides group info and the MatchGraph cache.                                      | `None`    |
| from_graph      | [bool](`bool`)              | If True (default), build/retrieve the full MatchGraph and return the FULL MatchStamp across ALL connected groups. If False, return a reduced 2-timeline MatchStamp. | `True`    |
| conversion_maps | \'ConversionMapsSpec\'      | C-map conversions available through unit lookup. Opt-in: defaults to ``False``.                                                                                     | `False`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                           |
|--------|------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchStamp \| None\' | MatchStamp with coordinates, or None if this claim is |
|        | \'MatchStamp \| None\' | non-synchronous (NOMATCH).                            |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If ``from_graph=True`` but no bundle is available (neither passed nor set via ``set_bundle()``). |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Full stamp (default -- from graph, all groups)::

    >>> stamp = claim.get_matchstamp()  # uses claim's bundle
    >>> stamp.n_timelines
    23  # score + 22 performers at this coordinate

Reduced stamp (two timelines only)::

    >>> stamp = claim.get_matchstamp(from_graph=False)
    >>> stamp.n_timelines
    2   # just the two timelines in this claim

### nomatch { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.nomatch }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.nomatch(
    event,
    source_tl_id,
    target_tl_id,
    *,
    unit,
    metadata=None,
)
```

Case (c): An event has no equivalent on the other timeline.

Creates a non-synchronous claim with no anchors (NOMATCH sentinel).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                  | Default    |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| event        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                   | Event dict from the source timeline. May contain ``id`` and ``name`` fields. | _required_ |
| source_tl_id | [str](`str`)                                                          | Source timeline's ID.                                                        | _required_ |
| target_tl_id | [str](`str`)                                                          | Target timeline's ID.                                                        | _required_ |
| unit         | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`)               | Unit of the source timeline's coordinate.                                    | _required_ |
| metadata     | [MatchMetadata](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchMetadata`) \| None | Provenance information.                                                      | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                   |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | A non-synchronous MatchClaim with no anchors but source event |
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | info. The source-side coordinate (``event["start"]``) is      |
|        | \'MatchClaim\' | preserved as ``source_coordinate`` for display.               |

### set_bundle { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.set_bundle }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.set_bundle(bundle)
```

Associate this claim with an AlignmentBundle.

This is called automatically when claims are added to a bundle.
Once set, ``get_matchstamp(from_graph=True)`` can be called
without passing the bundle explicitly.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                | Default    |
|--------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| bundle | [Any](`typing.Any`) | The AlignmentBundle containing this claim. | _required_ |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim.to_dict }

```python
alignment.MatchClaim.to_dict()
```

Serialize to dictionary for storage.

The values come straight from ``model_dump``; only the key order
and the omission of an absent ``source_claim_id`` are applied on
top, since both are part of the stored shape.
